integrity: The normalization defect and corrected formulas are derived symbolically from the target paper's stated general current-record formula and independently checked against the earlier Rayleigh specialization and the 2014 general formula.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the upper-current-record marginal CDF/PDF in Theorem 1 and consequences explicitly derived from that marginal density.
No claim is made that the separately stated joint-current-record likelihood is invalid solely because of this marginal-formula error.
The corrected density is a specialization of the known general current-record formula; the new contribution is the exact diagnosis and correction of the 2026 Weibull specialization.
A nonindexed corrigendum or equivalent later correction cannot be excluded.
title: The published Weibull upper-current-record density has total mass \((2/3)^m\), not one
